stats.name: fpi
stats.label: FPI
stats.description: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

stats.name: fpirank
stats.label: RK
stats.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

stats.name: rankchange7days
stats.label: TREND
stats.description: FPI Rank change from previous week.

stats.name: projectedw
stats.label: PROJ W-L
stats.description: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

stats.name: probwinout
stats.label: WIN OUT%
stats.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).

stats.name: prob6wins
stats.label: 6WINS%
stats.description: Percent of season simulations in which a team won at least 6 games (typically bowl-eligible).

stats.name: probwindiv
stats.label: WIN DIV%
stats.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference division, for those conferences that have divisions.

stats.name: probwinconf
stats.label: WIN CONF%
stats.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference, incorporating chance of getting to and winning conference championship game (if applicable). Accounts for shared conference titles in conferences that allow them.

stats.name: probmakeplayoffs
stats.label: PLAYOFF%
stats.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff, according to the Playoff Predictor.

stats.name: probmaketitlegame
stats.label: MAKE NC%
stats.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff National Championship game, according to the Playoff Predictor.

stats.name: probwintitle
stats.label: WIN NC%
stats.description: Chance to win the CFB Playoff National Championship, according to the Playoff Predictor.

notes.noteByView: The Football Power Index (FPI) is a measure of team strength that is meant to be the best predictor of a team's performance going forward for the rest of the season. FPI represents how many points above or below average a team is. Projected results are based on 20,000 simulations of the rest of the season using FPI, results to date, and the remaining schedule. Ratings and projections update daily. FPI data from seasons prior to 2019 may not be complete.
